EventData.Data: # SOC-002 PHASE 5 - CONTROLLED BENIGN TEST # Marker: SOC002-PHASE5-ENCODED-POWERSHELL # Purpose: harmless observable output only. No persistence, no network, no modification. $marker = 'SOC002-PHASE5-ENCODED-POWERSHELL' Write-Output $marker Write-Output ('HOST=' + $env:COMPUTERNAME) Write-Output ('USER=' + [System.Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent().Name) Write-Output ('START_UTC=' + (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.fffZ')) Start-Sleep -Seconds 3 Write-Output ('END_UTC=' + (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.fffZ')) Write-Output 'BENIGN_CONTROLLED_TEST_COMPLETE'
